tests.title: Failed contacts are retried on the next send and sent contacts are not
tests.goal: Clicking send again retries failed messages only.
preconditions: An isolated test app with a mocked Twilio transport; no real external message requests
An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
An approved template with a mapped variable
data: Use a mocked Twilio transport with two Pending contacts: one mock-success contact and one mock-API-failure contact.
Add separate disposable contacts already in Sent, Delivered and Read states, and keep their original data for comparison.
No external messages. Do not use a random phone number to provoke an error.

steps.text: Wait for the mocked batch to finish, click 刷新 and note each contact status

expected.text: The rejected contact is shown as failed, not 已發送
The second send reports 1 contact and sends only to the failed one
The mock-success contact receives only one send request in total
Previously Sent, Delivered and Read contacts receive no requests and remain unchanged

checks.label: The rejected contact is shown as failed, not 已發送
The second send reports 1 contact and sends only to the failed one
The mock-success contact receives only one send request in total
Previously Sent, Delivered and Read contacts receive no requests and remain unchanged

notes: Isolated source-handler integration only: actual send route and queue with in-memory Prisma/auth and mocked Twilio. Initial 2 Pending attempts produced Sent/Failed; second request sent only the Failed record. Previously Sent/Delivered/Read records were unchanged and received no requests. Third send returned 400 with zero requests. No real messages, DB writes, browser/UI or live-provider test.

tests.title: Resending a reset contact skips other sent, delivered and read contacts
tests.goal:
Resend one reset contact

Verify that resetting one completed contact makes it eligible again while other Sent, Delivered and Read contacts remain untouched.
preconditions: An admin account and an approved template are available.
An isolated test setup with a mocked transport contains disposable contacts in Sent, Delivered and Read states, with no other Pending or Failed contacts.
data: Use only disposable test records and mocked delivery; no real messages.

steps.text: Log in with your admin account and open the contact list.
Reset one Sent contact and confirm the reset.
Check that this contact alone changes to Pending and its old message and send information is cleared.
Send the template again and wait for the mocked batch to finish.
Inspect outgoing requests and compare the other contacts with their previous state.

expected.text: Exactly one outgoing request targets the reset contact.
The reset contact becomes Sent with a new message identifier.
Other Sent, Delivered and Read contacts receive no request and their data is unchanged.

checks.label: Exactly one outgoing request targets the reset contact.
The reset contact becomes Sent with a new message identifier.
Other Sent, Delivered and Read contacts receive no request and their data is unchanged.

notes: Actual reset route cleared the chosen in-memory contact to Pending; next actual send-handler invocation targeted only that reset record, made one mock request and assigned a new mock message ID. Other Sent/Delivered/Read fixtures untouched. Controlled integration, not live browser/database/Twilio. Retained sticker data untouched.

Two controlled source-integration cases passed; 10 assertions. Actual send/reset/queue code at app commit 1cdd076, mocked in-memory Prisma/auth and Twilio. Zero real messages or DB writes. Evidence/harness: explorations/2026-10-30-retry-skip/. No live UI/provider verification or concurrent-send test was performed.
